programme.title: Deadliest Catch: First Blood
programme.desc: The Bering Sea draws first blood in daring Coast Guard rescue Jake strives to become an independent captain, and Keith offers to take him on as an apprentice accusations fly and suspicions grow as the captains plunge head first into a brutal start.

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier: Making Hay the Kilcher Way
programme.desc: Eivin and August construct a unique hay baler that will take a load off their backs -- if it doesn't set them on fire first the family travels to the Copper River to dip net for red salmon Charlotte and Otto celebrate 25 years of marriage.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold: Unleash the Beast
programme.desc: Shawn's rival Ken unleashes his 600-ton gold gobbler while Shawn fights to keep a family dynasty Vernon makes a valiant return in an attempt to strike it rich with a new dredge, and Emily fights to reclaim her hotspot.

programme.title: Breaking Point: Belgaum Commando School: Life on the Edge
programme.desc: Soldiers continue training at commando school where they slide down 30-foot high platforms, wade through drains, navigate a hostile jungle and finish one of the toughest obstacle courses in the world.

programme.title: Incredible Engineering Blunders: Fixed
programme.desc: Justin climbs on top of a stadium roof that is held up by air and in danger of collapse checking out a new fleet of submarines that are too heavy to float.

programme.title: Dirty Mudder Truckers: The Dirty 7 vs. New England
programme.desc: The Dirty 7, a mega-truck racing crew from Central Florida, challenges teams from all over the country to find the fastest crew they race team New England in the Pit, a track of mud designed to put the trucks to the test for pride and money.

programme.title: America's Worst Tattoos: Tattooed in a Public Bathroom
programme.desc: Covering up a funny guy tattoo a friend saves the day by suggesting the portrait of a movie star.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: Sean and Casey forge an alliance, but the first catch threatens the tenuous agreement Wild Bill takes a big risk on a new idea hoping it will make up for a bumpy start a dangerous mistake jeopardizes Jake's offload.

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier: Homestead Overhaul
programme.desc: The Kilchers return, and with the family legacy in jeopardy, they start a complete homestead overhaul the family must rescue a tractor before the ice road melts a chimney fire could destroy Otto's cabin Eivin and Eve burn up brush piles.
